address: via cantine cattaneo 1, Sestri Levante, 16039, Italy
bio: A few management changes, but they are still in charge: Enrico in the kitchen and Nadia in the dining room. Already in a bucolic setting, but just a few steps from the centre and the sea, preceded by its own vegetable gardens, you dine within the restored 1590 walls of a former oil cellar, in a pleasantly rustic and romantic atmosphere overflowing with decorations. But the best comes with the cuisine, with no fish menu at all, with a strong focus on self-produced vegetables and succulent meat dishes, mostly barbecued with olive wood, along with a good selection of wines, mostly regional and high-quality....
